comments.body: @Luap99 should we just use `--net host` for the test?  I don't think it is worth to worry about this corner case (or relax the SELinux policy)

> @Luap99 should we just use --net host for the test? I don't think it is worth to worry about this corner case (or relax the SELinux policy)

Sure I suppose if these are just a few tests we can do that.
FWIW this has seemingly blown up the bud.bats test suite for me locally on Ubuntu 26.04

> FWIW this has seemingly blown up the bud.bats test suite for me locally on Ubuntu 26.04

Myriads of:

```
   error running container: did not get container start message from parent: EOF
   Error: building at STEP "RUN echo hello": setup network: pasta failed with exit code 1:
   Couldn't open PID file /var/tmp/pasta3628656508/pasta.pid: Permission denied
```
What OS are you running on, you pasta is likely to old and has not the proper apparmor/selinux rules to be allowed to write there.

> What OS are you running on, you pasta is likely to old and has not the proper apparmor/selinux rules to be allowed to write there.

As mentioned, Ubuntu 26.04, so the latest LTS :)
Well latest LTS means "outdated" packages still so yes your pasta is to old, the patch for this went into pasta in the last month or so. You need to add apparmor rules to allow pasta to write there.
